allow: Bash(/c/Windows/System32/cmd.exe /c "if exist ""%APPDATA%\\lex-tally-connector"" \(rmdir /s /q ""%APPDATA%\\lex-tally-connector"" && echo Cleared\) else \(echo No cache found\)")

Bash(powershell.exe -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3100 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host ''Port 3100 freed''")
Bash(powershell.exe -Command "Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force; Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; Write-Host ''All node processes killed''")
